title: [main] Upgrade important CI environment
body:
This PR upgrades important dependencies of the CI environment.

### Dependency floors

Raised:
- `boto3`, `botocore`: 1.42.79 → 1.42.93 (airflow-e2e-tests/pyproject.toml, providers/amazon/pyproject.toml, providers/hashicorp/pyproject.toml)
- `azure-keyvault-secrets`: 4.10.0 → 4.11.0 (providers/microsoft/azure/pyproject.toml)
- `google-api-python-client`: 2.193.0 → 2.194.0 (providers/google/pyproject.toml)
- `google-cloud-bigtable`: 2.35.0 → 2.36.0 (providers/google/pyproject.toml)
- `google-cloud-dataflow-client`: 0.12.0 → 0.13.0 (providers/google/pyproject.toml)
- `google-cloud-dlp`: 3.35.0 → 3.36.0 (providers/google/pyproject.toml)
- `google-cloud-pubsub`: 2.36.0 → 2.37.0 (providers/google/pyproject.toml)
- `google-cloud-spanner`: 3.63.0 → 3.65.0 (providers/google/pyproject.toml)
- `google-cloud-texttospeech`: 2.35.0 → 2.36.0 (providers/google/pyproject.toml)
- `google-cloud-translate`: 3.25.0 → 3.26.0 (providers/google/pyproject.toml)

Skipped:
- `azure-ai-projects`: 2.5+ needs openai>=3, broke main (#73621, #73627)
- `azure-kusto-data`: held back by !=5.0.0 in providers/microsoft/azure/pyproject.toml
- `azure-search-documents`: held back by !=12.0.0 in providers/microsoft/azure/pyproject.toml
